topic: Fewer products for sensitive skin (RIMAN calming gel)
text:
When my skin gets red and touchy, I don't add more. I take things away.

Cleanser. Calming gel. Moisturizer. That's it until it settles.

Sensitive skin over 70 wants less fuss, not more steps.

What's the one product you'd never give up?
